messages:
alex: heads-up: two pilot customers (AcmeHealth, RapidChat) asked for concrete guidance: batching defaults, prefix-KV caching strategy, quantized fallbacks, and eval-triggered regression alerts. want a minimal launch plan this week.
priya: can we map their priorities? which behavior do they expect by default vs opt-in?
sam: AcmeHealth = latency-sensitive (short chats). target p95 ~250-280ms. RapidChat = cost-sensitive, willing to trade +100-200ms for >20% per-token cost savings. both insist on automated quality alerts with actionable artifacts.
mila: suggest three lanes: Fast, Economy, Canary. Fast = conservative batching, warm prefix cache, no quant. Economy = larger batches, int8 fallback allowed with gating. Canary = safety checks + eval-alerting + throttled rollout.
alex: agreed. draft acceptance criteria below. open to adjustments.
priya: who's building the eval-alert plumbing?
ops-bot: eval-sentry is ready in prod; it can emit structured alerts to /alerts and tag by pilot/customer/model/delta.
priya: good. need SLA for alerts: delivered to console and to oncall within 3 minutes of regression detection. include top failing examples and recent request ids.
sam: proposed acceptance criteria:
- Fast lane: p95 <= 280ms on canonical 1-3 turn chats
- Economy lane: >= 25% median per-token cost reduction vs hosted baseline over a 24h window
- Quant fallback: only auto-enable if eval delta <= 1.0% (measured on customer's golden set)
- Eval alerts: detection -> console + pager within 3m, top 10 counterexamples attached, runbook link included
- Canary rollout: 5% traffic for 48h with shadowing + no critical alerts before widening
mila: how to measure "eval delta"? we should standardize metrics (e.g., embedding similarity + token-level overlap + human-specified checks). recommend default composite metric: 0.6*embed-sim + 0.4*task-score.
cassidy: Ops needs a short onboarding flow: upload golden set (50-150 prompts), choose metric, pick threshold. We'll provide a CLI for SEs to do quick local validation.
priya: add acceptance item for the CLI: must support `ri pilot upload-golden` and `ri pilot validate-variant` returning a pass/fail and quick diff summary.
sam: runtime constraints: KV cache variant compatibility is hard. MVP: no cross-variant KV sharing. fallback will require cache warm-up; document expected warm-up latency/cost and rate-limit automatic fallbacks to X rps per minute to avoid thundering herds.
ops-bot: noted: created INF-4510 for fallback rate-limit orchestration.
alex: rollout/beta plan:
- Today: finalize acceptance + customer one-pager (owner priya)
- 3d: runtime PR with per-lane batching defaults + fallback gate (owner sam)
- 7d: eval-alert hook + runbook + create canary (owner mila/cassidy)
- Post-canary: iterate thresholds based on false-positive rate and customer feedback
priya: one-pager must explain: what quant fallback is, expected style/behavior drift, warm-up costs, how alerts appear, and an opt-out path. also include KMS/data handling notes for regulated customers.
mila: suggest we also include a short table of recommended defaults per lane in the one-pager.
sam: sample batching policy for Economy lane (POC):
```json
{
  "lane": "economy",
  "max_batch_size": "48",
  "max_batch_tokens": "8192",
  "latency_slo_ms": "700",
  "prefix_kv_prefetch": "opportunistic"
}
```
keep Fast lane smaller and stricter.
cassidy: Ops targets for alerts: initial false positive rate target < 10% for 30 days. we'll tune thresholds and provide operators a simple dashboard to review recent alert hits.
alex: risks and mitigations:
- noisy eval signals -> mitigation: require sustained delta (>= threshold for 3 consecutive minutes) + impact (affects >3% recent requests) before paging
- cache incompatibility -> mitigation: document warm-up, throttle fallbacks, instrument cache hit metrics prominently in console
- overfitting to small golden sets -> mitigation: encourage >=100 prompts and provide guidance to diversify prompts
priya: legal/security: AcmeHealth needs checklist for demo artifacts and KMS usage. Cassidy, add security checklist item and loop in legal.
cassidy: added task to compliance board.
priya: small UX ask: show customers a simulated impact preview before enabling economy lane (estimate token cost delta and expected latency curves).
sam: implementing a quick estimator in the CLI is doable: `ri pilot estimate-impact --golden acme` will produce a short report.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: can create canaries with tags (edgepilot, canary, acme). who is owner?
alex: owners: sam (runtime + CLI), priya (customer comms + acceptance), mila (rollout gating + runbooks), cassidy (compliance).
mila: next sync Friday 10am PT to confirm acceptance doc and canary schedule. I'll draft the one-pager today.
priya: I'll invite SEs for AcmeHealth and RapidChat after the doc is posted.
alex: decision: move forward with Fast/Economy/Canary lanes, acceptance criteria as noted, owners assigned. next check-in Friday 10am PT.
mila: :thumbsup:
priya: thanks all.
sam: copying these notes into the project board and will open the runtime ticket.
alex: end of thread.
